values.quote: will be {{tip|stun|stunned}} for a total of {{fd|1.625}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Ornn deals damage to enemies he passes through during the dash, and again from a terrain-collision shockwave if they weren't already hit.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through and stopping upon colliding with terrain.

mechanics.claim: The shockwave only deals damage to enemies who were not already hit by the charge itself, meaning a given target can only take one instance of this damage.
mechanics.quote: deals the same damage if they were not already hit by the charge

mechanics.claim: Spell shields can only block one instance of this ability's damage (charge or shockwave, not both).
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} may only block one instance of damage.

mechanics.claim: Ornn will not dash after the cast time if he is airborne or resurrecting.
mechanics.quote: '''Ornn''' will not {{tip|dash}} after the cast time if he is {{tip|airborne}} or {{tip|resurrection|resurrecting}}.
